content: The architecture of our proposed model is shown in Figure FIGREF12 . The input is a list of tokens and the output are the predicted entity types. The ELMo embeddings are then used with a residual LSTM to learn informative morphological representations from the character sequence of each token. We then pass this to a softmax layer as a tag decoder to predict the entity types.
